Add a second pet

  1. Unlock an empty slot with coins.
  2. Choose an unlocked species (another cat is fine).
  3. Give them a name and tap Welcome them home.

Unlock a species in Style, then add a named friend to an empty slot. You can add another cat too.

Together, or just you two.

iPhone & iPad

Open this page in Safari. Tap Share → Add to Home Screen. Enable Open as Web App if it appears, then tap Add.

Android

Open this page in Chrome. Choose Install app or Add to Home screen from the menu.

Visit online once and wait for “Ready for offline visits.” Your pet lives inside the app.
